summary: Sprint 7 Slice 1 (Market Data) — 25/27 backend pytest passing (92.6%). Frontend /market/symbols renders correctly with header 'Markets' + LIVE badge, search filters (BTC->Bitcoin), 11 category tabs with correct counts (Forex Majors 7, Forex Minors 21, Forex Exotics 15, Metals 4, Energies 3, Indices 10, Crypto 30, Commodities 6), live prices with change %. /market dashboard shows 'Browse all' pill. /forex regression clean (XAU/EUR/GBP/JPY/BTC still there). WebSocket subscribe/ping/error round-trip works. Wallet send (no KYC) works, withdrawals still gated. TWO backend bugs found: (1) PUT /api/admin/market_data/settings returns 422 because AdminSettings model has all-Optional fields and FastAPI 0.110.1+Pydantic 2.13 treats it as query param instead of body. Blocks admin from changing interval/provider/api_keys. (2) Client calls /api/market_data/favorites without a token producing console 401 warnings for unauthenticated users on /market/symbols and /market. Deprecated shadow* CSS style props warning also fired.

critical.issue: 422 Unprocessable Entity — response says {"detail":[{"type":"missing","loc":["query","body"],"msg":"Field required"}]}. Root cause: AdminSettings pydantic model in /app/backend/market_data/routes.py:287-292 declares ALL fields as Optional with None defaults. FastAPI 0.110.1 + Pydantic 2.13 then treats the parameter as a query alias called `body` instead of a JSON body. Admin cannot update interval_seconds, provider, or api_keys — blocks entire Sprint 7 admin panel PUT flow. Fix: `from fastapi import Body` and change signature to `async def admin_put_settings(body: AdminSettings = Body(...), admin=Depends(...))` — or add one required field / model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow').

minor.issue: /app/frontend/app/market/symbols.tsx (and possibly the layout) calls /api/market_data/favorites without a Bearer token when user is logged out. Server returns 401 (correct) but console gets 4x 'Missing token' warnings on every /market/symbols and /market load. Gate the call by an isAuthed guard in useMarketFavorites / MarketDataClient.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID attributes anywhere on the browser screen (header, search input, tabs, list rows, star buttons). Blocks robust automated testing.

integration_issues.issue: Favorites endpoint is called on mount even for logged-out users, resulting in repeated 401 console errors. Screen still degrades gracefully (star buttons render as empty).

issues: Category tabs row overflows off-screen right of viewport 390px (Commodities partially hidden until user scrolls). Horizontal scroll works, but consider a subtle chevron/fade to hint scrollability.
Star icons (44px hit target) are edge-aligned tight against the right border — a 12–16px right padding would improve tap comfort.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — fired repeatedly on mount. Migrate elevation/shadow styles to the new API.

rca_of_issue: PUT /api/admin/market_data/settings 422 — REPRO: curl -X PUT /api/admin/market_data/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"interval_seconds":2}' returns {"detail":[{"type":"missing","loc":["query","body"],"msg":"Field required"}]}. RCA: FastAPI 0.110.1 with Pydantic 2.13.4 uses model field introspection to decide body-vs-query — when every field of a top-level model is Optional with default None, FastAPI treats it as an implicit query params container (each field becomes a query arg) rather than a JSON body. AdminSettings has provider/transport/interval_seconds/api_keys/enabled_categories all Optional. MITIGATION: annotate `body: AdminSettings = Body(...)` (recommended), OR make one field required (breaks partial-update), OR change signature to `body: Dict[str, Any] = Body(...)` and validate manually.
